name: ABO Basic Certification Exam
administrator: American Board of Opticianry & National Contact Lens Examiners
delivery: Secure computer-based exam delivered by Prometric at 300+ test centers or via ProProctor remote proctoring (own computer with camera, microphone, internet). Offered in quarterly testing windows; English and Spanish versions.
scoring: Criterion-referenced pass/fail; the minimum passing score is set by subject-matter experts using the Modified Angoff Method. Preliminary result shown immediately, emailed report within hours; failing reports include diagnostic feedback per content area. No penalty for guessing; unanswered items are scored incorrect.
eligibility: High school diploma, GED, or equivalent (exceptions for dual-enrollment high school students). No experience required. State licensing rules supersede ABO-NCLE's where they differ. Candidates with an active basic certification may not retake the basic exam.
retakePolicy: Retake allowed after a 14-day wait. After three unsuccessful attempts, a 90-day wait applies before the next attempt. Each attempt requires a new registration and fee; fees are non-refundable.

notes: Sources: ABO-NCLE Basic Exam Handbook (October 2026, linked from the official Basic Exams page) and the Basic Exams page, both read 2026-11-04.
125 multiple-choice questions; the test specifications total 100 scored questions, so about 25 are unscored pretest items. Four answer choices per question.
2-hour time limit; on-screen scientific calculator; items can be flagged and revisited before the section ends. Timer keeps running during breaks.

Fee $275 per the October 2026 handbook and the Basic Exams page (the February 2025 handbook listed $225). Combined Basic + Practical exam (NOCOP), where state-approved: $300, 3 hours. Rescheduling/window transfer: $75.
The ABO Practical exam (ABOP) must be taken at a Prometric center; the Basic exam may be taken remotely. Confirm your state board accepts remote proctoring for licensing before scheduling.
2024 pass rate for the ABO Basic exam: 64.0% (ABO-NCLE).
Remaining 2026 window: October 1 - December 21 (registration closes November 15, no late registration). 2027 windows: Jan 2 - Mar 31, Apr 1 - Jun 30, Jul 1 - Sep 30, Oct 1 - Dec 21.
Register and pay on abo-ncle.org; the scheduling link arrives by email 24-48 hours later, then book with Prometric.

Certification (ABOC) is renewed every 3 years: 12 approved CECs, at least 6 ABO-approved ophthalmic. ABO-NCLE's Basic Certification Renewal page lists a $125 fee while its Renewals and Reinstatements page lists $175; confirm with ABO-NCLE. The handbook mentions a 90-day grace period, but the Renewals and Reinstatements page says there is no grace period and lapsed certifications must be reinstated, so renew before your expiration date.

Advanced (ABO-AC, also written ABOC-AC): requires an active ABO Basic certification plus one completed 3-year recertification period; 3-hour exam, center or remote. The April-June 2026 event page listed a $225 fee. 2024 pass rate: 52.0%.

Certification (NCLEC) is renewed every 3 years: 18 approved CECs, at least 9 NCLE-approved ophthalmic. Dual ABO+NCLE holders: 9 ABO CECs (5 ophthalmic) and 12 NCLE CECs (6 ophthalmic). ABO-NCLE pages list the renewal fee as both $125 and $175; confirm with ABO-NCLE.

Advanced (NCLE-AC): requires an active NCLE Basic certification plus one completed 3-year recertification period. 2024 pass rate: 42.0%. Fee and length for the NCLE Advanced were not confirmed on a page read today.
